newsitem.title: USA: Motorola gets $40 million China contract.
newsitem.headline: Motorola gets $40 million China contract.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Monday its Asia/Pacific Cellular Infrastructure Group signed a $40 million agreement to expand cellular phone service in Shanghai.

The company said the Shanghai Posts & Telecommunications Bureau has already begun the installation of the Motorola equipment. It will increase capacity on the TACS (Total Access Communications System) network to 200,000 subscribers from 134,000.
Motorola's TACS system was originally installed in 1986 and has been upgraded periodically. Motorola has TACS networks in 23 provinces and multiples in China the company said.
